'''July 2001 Orland Park tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Orland Park, IL in July 2001. It is known from Scott Sichta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2742">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-30-wtf-is-the-egg-timer-for-then-orland-ild2742/ wtf-is-the-egg-timer-for-then-orland-il], DeckTech (Scott "snoova69" Sichta, 30 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-30-wtf-is-the-egg-timer-for-then-orland-ild2742/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' July 2001
* '''Site:''' Orland Park, IL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
